import csv
tsid='47652864-1667-59d9-8666-a2e27c774441'
vals=[]
for r in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if r['timeseries_id']==tsid:
        vals.append((r['timestamp'], float(r['value'])))
vals.sort()
print('n total', len(vals))
mx=max(v for _,v in vals)
half=mx/2
day=[v for t,v in vals if t.startswith('2018-01-27')]
print('day count', len(day))
print('max', mx, 'half', half)
cnt=sum(1 for v in day if v>half)
print('count above half on day', cnt)
print(day)
